transcript.answer: Otto rejects the `global` endpoint because it gives up EU data residency, and the model allowlist exists to enforce that residency. The Gemini 3.x family is served from no single EU region. It is available only on `global` and, since 21 May 2026, on the `eu` multi-region. Otto therefore pins `gemini-3.1-flash-lite` to the `eu` multi-region, which uses the host `aiplatform.eu.rep.googleapis.com`. The provider block sets that host as `apiEndpoint`, because the Vertex SDK doesn't derive it from `location`. `gemini-2.5-flash-lite` on `europe-west1` was a short-lived stopgap, because Google retires it on 16 October 2026. One caveat: the claim that `global` serves every Gemini model is not what the sources say. They describe 3.x as available only on `global` and `eu`, while `europe-west1` serves the 2.5 family.
